decisions.reason: Because the mitred door lever handle family remained on the website in both 2023 and 2024, management is likely to continue it absent clear failure, especially after already investing in launch and market presence.
Its move from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024 signals increasing public commitment and product importance, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.

Although it appears less prominently than the more strategic lines, it is still shown in both years and a German hardware maker would typically keep such a launched handle model on offer unless results were clearly poor.
This collection has its own page, repeated award communication, and strong visible commitment, so management would be very unlikely to remove such a publicly validated product within the next year.
